question: What are the top 3 months between 2010 and 2014 with the smallest sum of absolute differences between the average air temperature, wet bulb temperature, dew point temperature, and sea surface temperature, including respective years and sum of differences? Please present the year and month in numerical format.

-- The results look reasonable. The smallest sum of absolute differences are in summer months (June-August),
-- which makes sense because all temperatures are higher and closer together.
-- The top 3 with smallest sum are:
-- 2010,7 with 13.0125
-- 2010,8 with 13.0600
-- 2010,6 with 13.4070
--
-- Now let me re-read the question carefully:
-- "What are the top 3 months between 2010 and 2014 with the smallest sum of absolute differences between the average air temperature, wet bulb temperature, dew point temperature, and sea surface temperature, including respective years and sum of differences? Please present the year and month in numerical format."
--
-- The question says "sum of absolute differences between the average air temperature, wet bulb temperature, dew point temperature, and sea surface temperature"
-- This is ambiguous. Let me consider:
-- 1. Sum of all pairwise absolute differences (what I computed) - 6 pairs
-- 2. Sum of differences between consecutive temperatures in the list
-- 3. Sum of absolute values of each temperature (unlikely)
--
-- Interpretation 1 seems most natural for "absolute differences between [list of items]"
--
-- Let me finalize the query with just year, month, and sum_abs_diff, ordered ascending.
-- The question asks for year and month in numerical format.

WITH monthly_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    year, month,
    AVG(air_temperature) as avg_air,
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature) as avg_wet,
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature) as avg_dew,
    AVG(sea_surface_temp) as avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2010` 
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
  GROUP BY year, month

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 
    year, month,
    AVG(air_temperature),
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature),
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature),
    AVG(sea_surface_temp)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2011` 
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
  GROUP BY year, month

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 
    year, month,
    AVG(air_temperature),
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature),
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature),
    AVG(sea_surface_temp)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2012` 
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
  GROUP BY year, month

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 
    year, month,
    AVG(air_temperature),
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature),
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature),
    AVG(sea_surface_temp)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013` 
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
  GROUP BY year, month

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 
    year, month,
    AVG(air_temperature),
    AVG(wetbulb_temperature),
    AVG(dewpoint_temperature),
    AVG(sea_surface_temp)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2014` 
  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
  GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT 
  CAST(year AS INT64) as year, 
  CAST(month AS INT64) as month,
  ABS(avg_air - avg_wet) + ABS(avg_air - avg_dew) + ABS(avg_air - avg_sst) +
  ABS(avg_wet - avg_dew) + ABS(avg_wet - avg_sst) + ABS(avg_dew - avg_sst) as sum_abs_diff
FROM monthly_avgs
ORDER BY sum_abs_diff ASC
LIMIT 3
